q: Which statement is true?
why: \(\sqrt{3}\) is irrational but every real number includes irrationals, so \(\sqrt{3}\) is real. The other statements are false: \(\sqrt{5}\) is irrational, 0 is neither positive nor negative, and \(\sqrt{4} = 2\) is rational.

q: The thousandths digit of the number 1,234.5678 is ________.
why: Place values after the decimal are tenths (5), hundredths (6), thousandths (7)... wait recount: 1,234.5678 -> tenths=5, hundredths=6, thousandths=7, ten-thousandths=8. So the thousandths digit is 7.

q: The greatest common divisor of 91, 39 and 78 is ________.
why: 91 = 7 x 13, 39 = 3 x 13, 78 = 2 x 3 x 13. The common factor is 13, so GCD = 13.

q: Which of the following is a true proportion?
why: 5/4 = 1.25 and 15/12 = 1.25, so 5:4 = 15:12 is a true proportion. The other pairs of ratios are not equal.

q: 1/8 expressed in percent is ________.
What do you call an equality of 2 ratios?
why: A proportion is a statement that two ratios are equal.

q: The number of hours spent for review in Algebra, Chemistry and English is in the ratio of 4:3:1. How many hours does a student spend on Chemistry in a 24-hour review package?
why: Total parts = 4+3+1 = 8. Each part = 24/8 = 3 hours. Chemistry gets 3 parts = 3 x 3 = 9 hours.

q: What is the value of 3.5 kilograms in grams?

why: Rate = 6/4 = 1.5 minutes per page. For 10 pages: 10 x 1.5 = 15 minutes.

q: Four people can finish painting a room within 4 hours. If only 2 people are available, how many hours do they have to work to finish the same job?
why: Total work = 4 people x 4 hours = 16 person-hours. With 2 people: 16/2 = 8 hours.

q: 72 is 3/4 of what number?
why: Let x be the number: (3/4)x = 72, so x = 72 / (3/4) = 72 x 4/3 = 96.

q: How much greater is the sum of the first 100 counting numbers than the sum of the first 50 counting numbers?
why: Sum of first n counting numbers = n(n+1)/2. Sum of first 100 = 5,050; sum of first 50 = 1,275. Difference = 5,050 - 1,275 = 3,775.

q: A water tank contains 18 liters when it is 20% full. How many liters does it contain when 50% full?

q: In a certain school, the ratio of boys to girls is 5 is to 7. If there are 180 boys and girls in the school, how many boys are there?
why: Total parts = 5+7 = 12. Each part = 180/12 = 15. Boys = 5 x 15 = 75.

q: Nelia takes 3/4 hour to dress and get ready for school. It takes 4/5 hour to reach the school. If her class starts promptly at 8:00 am, what is the latest time she can get out of bed in order not to be late for school?
why: Total time needed = 3/4 + 4/5 = 0.75 + 0.80 = 1.55 hours = 1 hour 33 minutes. Latest wake-up time = 8:00 am - 1:33 = 6:27 am.

q:

II. When the last digit of the number is either 0 or 5. 
III. When the number is a multiple of 4.

why: A number is divisible by 5 if and only if its last digit is 0 or 5 — statement II only.

q: How many positive divisors does 36 have?

q: Which of the following sets of numbers has a least common multiple of 315?

q: A machine has three LED lights that blink in varied intervals: red every 8 seconds, blue every 12 seconds, yellow every 18 seconds. If all lights blinked together at exactly 3:00 p.m., how many more times will they blink together altogether until 3:30 p.m.?

why: 4 units of the false 12-inch marking equal 4 x 11.5 = 46 true inches = 3 ft 10 in.

q: How many grams are there in one petagram?
why: The prefix peta- means \(10^{15}\), so 1 petagram = \(10^{15}\) grams.

q: A slow moving snail traveled 4,800 mm. How far did it travel in kilometers?
A meter stick was cut into two pieces at the 36cm mark. What is the ratio of the smaller piece to the larger piece?
What is the greatest integral divisor of the numbers 42 and 60?
The LCM of two counting numbers is 42 and their GCF is 7. If one of them is 21, what is the other number?
why: LCM x GCF = product of numbers: 42x7=21x other, so other=14.

q: What number subtracted from each 71 and 58 will result in two perfect squares?
A dark neon light blinks every 4 seconds, a blue light blinks every 5 seconds while a white one blinks every 6 seconds. How many times do they blink together in one hour?
Which of the following is NOT true about the sum of two consecutive odd integers?
options: it is always divisible by one
it is only divisible by twelve
why: The sum of two consecutive odd integers is always divisible by 4, but it is not always divisible by 12.

q: What are the two digits which when inserted in the blank spaces will make 934__ __ divisible by eight?
why: Appending 00 gives 93400, and its last three digits (400) are divisible by 8.

q: It takes 20 workers to build a house for 60 days. How many workers will be needed to build it in 15 days?
why: Total work = 20x60=1200 worker-days. For 15 days: 1200/15=80 workers.

q: The introductory price of a certain item was P12. What is the percent increase in the price of the item if two years later its price is P42?
Which is a set of equivalent fractions?
why: 2/3, 4/6, and 8/12 all reduce to the same value, 2/3.

q: What is the smallest positive number (other than 3) which gives a remainder of 3 when divided by 4, 6 or 8?
why: The number must be 3 more than a multiple of LCM(4,6,8)=24, so the next value after 3 is 3+24=27.

q: The ratio of males to females in an organization is 3:2. How many males are there if there are 20 employees total?
A man bought a watch and sold it 30% more than its original cost. How much did the man gain if the original cost of the watch is P?
why: The gain is 30% of the original cost P, or 30% x P.

q: How much is left from a ₱100.00 bill after paying for a dozen of mangoes at N pesos per mango?
why: A dozen costs 12N pesos, so the money left is ₱100 - N(12).

q: An employee spends about ₱3,332 a month. This sum is 70% of his monthly salary. How much does he receive a month?
A train travels 268 kilometers in 4 hours. How many kilometers can it travel in 9 hours if it is moving at the same rate?

A falling body starting from rest falls 16.1 feet the first second, 48.3 feet the next second, 80.5 feet the third second, and so on. How many feet does it fall in T seconds (i.e., during the Tth second)?
why: Each successive second adds 32.2 ft, so distance in the Tth second = 16.1 + 32.2(T-1).

q: A man walks at a rate of 7.2 kilometers per hour. How many meters per minute does he walk?

The average rate of an employee walking is 1,680 meters per hour. If the distance of his office from his house is 700 meters, what will be the latest time that he can leave his house to be able to reach his office exactly 7:45 a.m.?
why: Time needed = 700/1680 hours = 25 minutes. Latest departure = 7:45 - 0:25 = 7:20 a.m.

q: How many baby dresses can a dressmaker finish in 5 days if she can finish an average of 23 dresses in 1/2 day?
why: Rate = 23 per half-day = 46 per day. 5 x 46 = 230.

q: If a 6-foot man casts a shadow of 4 feet, how tall is a boy who casts a shadow of 3 feet?
An office requested a cash advance of ₱23,000 for the purchase of reference materials and office supplies. What amount was released to the office if only 12% of the amount requested was granted?

The population of a certain barangay at the present time is 5,000. If it gains 5% of this population by births and loses 3% of this population by deaths regularly each year for 5 consecutive years, what is the population at the end of that time?
why: Net growth = (5%-3%) x 5000 x 5 years = 500. Population = 5000+500 = 5,500.

q: A merchant made a profit of ₱10,200 for the first year and ₱12,444 for the second year. Find the percent of increase in profit.
What whole number or integer, other than 1 or 53, when divided into 53 yields another whole number?
why: Since 53 is prime, its only divisors are 1 and 53, so no other whole number divides evenly into it.

q: Which of the following has the least numerical value?
Which of the following integer ranges show the largest increase?
options: none of the above (all show equal increase)
why: Each range shows an increase of exactly 3, so none is individually larger than the others.

q: A farmer paid ₱648,000 for a lot 15 meters wide and 36 meters long. What is the price of the lot per square meter?
Danny can shoot 6 out of 9 baskets. Jane can shoot 15 out of 24 baskets. Ramie can shoot 25 out of 70 baskets. Ronnie can shoot 30 out of 65 baskets. Who has the lowest percentage shot?
why: Percentages: Danny 66.7%, Jane 62.5%, Ramie 35.7%, Ronnie 46.2%. Ramie has the lowest.

q: The original price of a pair of jogging pants was ₱300. What was the rate of the discount after paying ₱195?
If 20 deep wells can produce 4,760 gallons per minute, what is the average number of gallons per minute can each deep well produce?
A man who purchased 35 copies of a magazine was billed ₱1,470. If he decided to take one more copy at the same price, how much would he pay for all the magazines?
The seventh term of a geometric sequence is 192 and its common ratio is r = 2. Find the second term.
A printing press turns out 22,680 newspapers in 2 hours and 20 minutes. How many newspapers does it turn out per minute?
why: 2 hr 20 min = 140 minutes. 22,680/140 = 162 newspapers per minute.

q: An agency with 3,200 employees plans to reduce its staff by 35%. How many employees are to be retained?
If 5/6 of the 150 families of a certain barangay are farmers, how many families are farmers?
For an extraordinary sale an agent received 25% commission. If his commission was ₱1,650, what was the amount of the sale?
If 59.5% of the employees are females, and 81 are male employees, what is the total number of employees in the office?
The ratio of children to adults in a barrio is 4:7. How many adults are there if there are 3,000 children?
After a four day vacation Mr. Mendoza noticed that for every 19 employees present, 4 employees were absent. If the total number of employees was 552, how many employees were present?
How many cubic millimeters are there in 3 cubic centimeters?
The country's over 0.35M public elementary school teachers and officials receive a general increase. The numeral 0.35 M refers to ___.
If eight girls share 3/4 of an apple pie, what part of the pie did each girl get?
What is the sum of 1/2, 1/4 and 1/3?
A boat scheduled to arrive at 3:35 p.m. on a particular day was delayed by 13 hours. At what time did it arrive the following day?
why: 3:35 p.m. + 13 hours = 4:35 a.m. the next day.

q: An umbrella which previously cost ₱100 is now marked ₱90, with the same percentage of discount. How much will an umbrella which previously cost P90 be sold?
why: The discount rate is 10%. 90% of 90 = P81.

q: Mrs. Rojas attended a clearance sale where prices of all items were reduced by 25%. She bought a blazer regularly priced ₱140 and an umbrella regularly priced P99. How much did she save on these two items?
A merchant repacks a 60 kg sack of sugar into small packs of 750g. How many small packs can he make?
One fourth of the width and one fifth of the length of a sheet of cartolina are cut off. What percent of the original sheet is the remaining area?
why: Remaining width=3/4, remaining length=4/5. Remaining area = (3/4)(4/5) = 3/5 = 60%.

q: On a 12-hour hand, find x so that 3+x=1.
In how many ways can the letters from the word SYZYGY be arranged?
why: SYZYGY has 6 letters with Y repeated 3 times: 6!/3! = 720/6 = 120.

q: What is the value of x that will satisfy this given: 30 = x (mod 8)?
why: 30 divided by 8 gives remainder 6, so x = 6.

q: What is the sum of 21 = 1(mod 5) and 23 = 3(mod 5)?
Find the value of phi(71), the Euler totient function.
Which property of integers is illustrated by a + b = b + a?
why: Changing the order of addition without changing the result is the commutative property.

q: Which property of integers is illustrated by a + 0 = a?
why: Adding zero leaves the number unchanged, illustrating the identity property.

q: Which of the following is not a perfect number?
why: 6, 28, and 496 are perfect numbers (equal to the sum of their proper divisors); 12 is not.

q: Find the units modulo of Z9 with a binary operation of multiplication modulo 9.
why: The units modulo 9 are the elements coprime to 9 (excluding multiples of 3): {1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8}.

q: Find the units modulo of Z12 with a binary operation of multiplication modulo 12.
why: The units modulo 12 are the elements coprime to 12: {1, 5, 7, 11}.

q: Express decimally: Seven hundred twenty-five hundred-thousandths.
The temperature 45°C is equal to ____.
The prefix pico means ____.
why: The SI prefix pico denotes a factor of \(10^{-12}\).

q: What is the least common multiple of 15 and 18?
Ten less than four times a certain number is 14. Determine the number.
What time after 3 o'clock will the hands of the clock be together for the first time?
why: Hands align at (60/11)*H minutes past the hour: (60/11)*3 = 16.36 minutes, so 3:16.36.

q: Find the 6th term of: 2, 5, 8, ...
why: This is an arithmetic sequence with common difference 3. The 6th term = 2 + 5(3) = 17.

q: If 22 is congruent to 12 mod 5 and -1 is congruent to 14 mod 5, find the sum of the two congruences.
why: Adding the left sides gives 22 + (-1) = 21, and adding the right sides gives 12 + 14 = 26. Both 21 and 26 have a remainder of 1 when divided by 5, so 21 is congruent to 26 mod 5.

q: Find the remainder when 1! + 2! + 3! + ... + 1110! is divided by 10.
why: For n greater than or equal to 5, n! contains a factor of 10 and contributes nothing to the remainder. Only 1!+2!+3!+4! = 1+2+6+24 = 33 matters, and 33 mod 10 = 3.

q: Joy argues that 12 is congruent to -10 (mod 11). Is she correct? Why?
why: Two numbers are congruent mod n if n divides their difference. Since 12 - (-10) = 22, and 11 divides 22 (which is the same as 11 dividing 12+10), the congruence holds.

q: Find the remainder when 250 is divided by 11.
why: Since 11 x 22 = 242, subtracting from 250 gives a remainder of 8.

q: What is the quotient when 100 is divided by 7 using the div operator?
why: Since 7 x 14 = 98 with a remainder of 2, the integer quotient (div) of 100 by 7 is 14.

q: A certain number is doubled and then divided by 8. If after subtracting 4 from the result, one gets 16, the original number is ___.
why: Let x be the number: \(\frac{2x}{8} - 4 = 16\), so \(\frac{2x}{8} = 20\), 2x = 160, x = 80.

q: Mr. Lucido deposited 215 pesos using 29 bills of 5-peso and 10-peso denominations. How many 10-peso bills did he deposit?
why: Let a = number of 5-peso bills and b = number of 10-peso bills. a + b = 29 and 5a + 10b = 215; solving gives b = 14.

q: What is the remainder when 1! + 2! + 3! + ... + 1000! is divided by 12?
why: For n greater than or equal to 4, n! is divisible by 12; only 1! + 2! + 3! = 1 + 2 + 6 = 9 contributes, so the remainder is 9.

q: Joy argues that 12 = 1 (mod 11). Is she correct? Why?
options: No, because 12 is not equal to -10 + 1(1)
why: Since 12 - 1 = 11 and 11 divides 11 evenly, the congruence 12 = 1 (mod 11) is correct.

q: Find the product of the two congruences 12 = 5 (mod 7) and 8 = -6 (mod 7).
why: Multiplying both sides preserves the modulus: 12 x 8 = 96 and 5 x (-6) = -30, so 96 = -30 (mod 7).

q: Find the remainder when 1! + 2! + 3! + 4! is divided by 3.
why: 1 + 2 + 6 + 24 = 33, and 33 divided by 3 leaves a remainder of 0.

q: What is the greatest common factor (GCF) of 24 and 36?
why: The largest number dividing both 24 and 36 evenly is 12.

q: What is the smallest prime number greater than 20?
why: 23 is prime and is the smallest prime number greater than 20, since 21 and 22 are not prime.
